idea-plugin.name: TCVN3 Vietnamese Encoding
idea-plugin.description:
Adds the legacy Vietnamese TCVN3 (also known as ABC) encoding to all JetBrains IDEs. After installing, "TCVN3" appears in the encoding dropdown (status bar / File Encoding settings) and works for file open / save / Find in Files like any built-in charset.

Includes:
  • Charset registered via Java SPI - integrates with the IDE's built-in encoding system.
  • Round-trip safe - non-TCVN3 bytes (e.g. GBK Chinese filenames inside game data files) decode into the Unicode Private Use Area and re-encode byte-identical. Save without corrupting paths.
  • Clipboard bridge actions for copying to / pasting from tools like Notepad++ that show TCVN3 via .VnTime + ANSI:
    • TCVN3: Copy as bytes (Ctrl+Alt+C)
    • TCVN3: Paste from bytes (Ctrl+Alt+V)
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 1.0.0 - Initial release. Charset registration + clipboard bridge actions. Mirrors the same codec used by the VS Code patch (vs-code-tcvn3-customize).

action.description: Copy the selection as TCVN3 bytes (Latin-1 wire form). Use to paste into Notepad++/Notepad in ANSI + .VnTime mode.
Interpret the clipboard as TCVN3 bytes and paste decoded Vietnamese text. Use after copying from Notepad++/Notepad in ANSI + .VnTime mode.
